scenes.text: Imagine being the only tree for two hundred and fifty miles in every single direction, surviving completely alone in the harsh Sahara Desert against all odds.
This was the famous Tree of Ténéré, a historic acacia tree that was considered the most isolated tree on Earth, used by caravan travelers as a life-saving landmark.
But in 1973, a truck driver allegedly heavily drunk, managed to drive across hundreds of miles of empty, flat desert and crashed directly into this one single tree, knocking it down.

It sounds like a completely unbelievable story, but today a metal sculpture stands where it once grew. Would you have managed to hit that tree? Drop a comment and follow for more mind-blowing history.
